name: history-bioscope
description: History Bioscope – Interactive Historical Timeline & Geo-Visualization Platform

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.seed: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run sync-seed
